overall: The AG found no violation: the Town Clerk posted notices for the July 20 and August 17 meetings more than 48 hours ahead in the official binder at Town Hall, and website posting is not required.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the school committee failed to properly post notice of its July 20 and August 17, 2021 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the notices were properly posted in compliance with the Law where the Town Clerk posted the notices for the Committee’s July 20 and August 17 meetings more than 48 hours in advance in the official notice posting location.

allegations.summary: Complaint's posting challenge also raised whether notices had to appear on the town or committee website; the AG addressed the website posting question.
allegations.key_passage: There is no requirement that a meeting notice also be posted to either the Town or Committee website.
